description:
The Limited-Edition Ford Mustang eBike celebrates 60 years of the legendary Mustang. True to history, the eBike features the original Rangoon Red paintwork of 1964.5 and period-correct badges and decals from Ford’s archives – complimented with a 60th anniversary plaque.
Chromed-look finished wheels and a power unit complete this very special eBike limited to just 500 units.
One for the collector.

The Mustang electric bike generates one horsepower (750W*) of electric boost that easily accelerates to 28 MPH** (in pedal assist, Class 3 mode with the rider pedaling) with plenty of torque on-demand.
The eBike features the iconic Mustang LED Sequential Taillights and an integrated one-piece cockpit cradles a full color display with telemetry graphics inspired by Ford's digital infotainment system.
Designed for the street and tuned for fast rides with semi-slick Pirelli Angel tires and dual suspension designed to keep the bike firmly planted over surface imperfections.
Powered by a 48V, 15Ah | 720Wh battery, the Mustang electric bike can cruise up to 60 miles ***, and riders can take advantage of four power power modes – Eco, Normal, Sport, and Track.
